description: Use this when the user wants upcoming concerts, sports, theatre or other live events by performer or event name, city, country, category or dates. Returns cached provider listings in date order. Each upcoming event has its TicketSea page (url) and a tickets link: the seller's page for that exact event, else another seller's (detail says what it is), else the TicketSea page. Not live inventory, and nothing is purchased. Use nextOffset to page, and narrow the filters when scanLimited is true.

city.description: City the user asked about, such as Seattle, or a postal code (98101). For "near me", pass "near me": ChatGPT's approximate location places it; elsewhere use the user's city if you know it, else ask.

query.description: Artist, team, event or venue text.

name: search_events
title: Find upcoming events
